definitions.context: one-shot four-way family cue accompanying raw NEW/REPLACE payload; mapped targets never enter the model
definitions.primary: eligible post-fork requests under the evaluation NEW contract, with matured deadlines
definitions.conditional_finish: argmax of the existing eight FINISH logits on the branch's own actual hidden state
definitions.legal_finish: active, BEGIN accepted, ready_time <= now <= deadline; ignores chosen content
definitions.first_legal: first observed legal opportunity per request since this fork; inherited history may precede it
definitions.cue: existing eight-FINISH readout once after consuming NEW/REPLACE and before taking that tick's action
definitions.cue_legal_pair: same matured final-eligible request with observed cue and first observed legal readout; excludes never-legal cases
definitions.cue_legal_transition: both_correct/lost/gained/both_wrong partition the matched pair population; cue-correct denominator is both_correct+lost
definitions.first_error: first rejected active-request attempt; simultaneous causes retained as a disjoint pattern
definitions.idle: enabled job slot with no active task before its action; separate from disabled slots
definitions.terminal_time: observed post-fork completion/cancellation/expiry; inherited inactive causes remain unknown
definitions.retired_content: a correct retained FINISH readout is not an error when the model appropriately chooses WAIT

limitations: Conditional readout combines encoding, retention and existing-head access; it does not prove information absence.
Incorrect immediate cue readout means the native FINISH head did not read the content at that phase; it does not prove failed encoding.
Cue-to-legal transitions condition on requests reaching a legal opportunity; no-cue/no-legal exclusions and matured denominators remain separate.
Active opportunities and first legal times depend on the policy; compare their populations before interpreting accuracy differences.
A complete checkpoint preserves inherited state but cannot reconstruct unlogged pre-fork first errors or terminal times.
